name: solution25/smarty-address-validation
description: Smarty Address Validation plugin for Shopware 6 integrates the Smarty Streets API to validate and standardize customer addresses at checkout, reducing failed deliveries.

description.en-GB: Smarty Address Validation for Shopware 6 integrates the SmartyStreets API to validate customer shipping addresses at checkout, reducing failed deliveries and improving accuracy.
description.de-DE: Smarty Adressvalidierung für Shopware 6 nutzt die SmartyStreets-API, um Kundenadressen beim Checkout zu prüfen und zu standardisieren – für weniger Lieferfehler.
